notes: HEAD 81b3bea490e9b45221c82e78387920ccfeb05b33, curve-stablecoin. Vyper 0.4.3 except OwnerProxy.vy (0.3.10) and the two .sol oracles (Solidity 0.8.25).

IPriceOracle interface: price() view + price_w() stateful. Controllers/AMMs consume price_w() in state-changing flows; price() in views. EMA oracles: price() and price_w() can diverge within a block (price_w persists EMA state).

EMA module (curve_std/ema.vy, context): read() = prev*mul + queued*(WAD-mul), mul=exp(-dt/ema_time); update() returns smoothed value from PREVIOUS queued value and queues the new value. The three EMA oracles snap the EMA down directly (prev==queued==spot) on downside moves, bypassing update()'s overflow assert.

Controller callback flow (controller.vy, context): create_loan/borrow_more transfer _debt borrowed tokens to the callbacker BEFORE _execute_callback, then pull collateral from callbacker AFTER. repay: AMM.withdraw then transfer position collateral to callbacker, then callback. _execute_callback asserts active_band/bands_x/bands_y unchanged across the callback.

TransientLeverageZap: entry points stash swap params in transient storage, call controller with callback=self and empty calldata; callbacks authenticate via stashed_controller == msg.sender. Entry points are NOT @nonreentrant (stash emptiness is the guard); callbacks ARE @nonreentrant (shared contract-wide lock). Exchange whitelist is admin-managed; swap uses approve(max_spent)->raw_call->approve(0).

TransientLeverageZapMint reuses TransientLeverageZapLend as a module (core) but passes the MINT factory address to core.__init__ (typed ILendFactory); only admin()/set_exchange() use the factory address in the Mint deployment; controller lookup uses the mint factory's controllers().

HyperbolicMP/DynamicMP: rate = target_rate*r_minf/WAD + A*target_rate/(u_inf-u) + rate_shift, clamped at 0. u_inf asserted > WAD at param-set time. Utilization = total_debt/(available_balance+total_debt-admin_fees), capped at WAD. DynamicMP reads the calculator via non-reverting raw_call; failure/empty returndata -> 0 -> clamped to MIN_TARGET_RATE (~1% APR).

Configurator: default_admin + per-controller custom admins; set_owner/set_custom_admin are default-admin-only. set_price_oracle validates the new oracle (price_w + price) and enforces <=50% deviation vs old price unless _max_deviation == max_value(uint256) (documented escape hatch for broken oracles). set_monetary_policy calls controller.configure then controller.save_rate() (order matters: check which MP rate save_rate accrues with). Module-level #pragma nonreentrancy on.

ControllerView: view-only; deployed per-market from a blueprint via controller.configure; controller forwards health/max_borrowable/min_collateral/user_state/users_to_liquidate calls to it. Shares core._get_y_effective and core._get_f_remove with controller.vy. users_with_health loop bound 10**6 with DynArray cap 1000 (CS-CURVE-LLV2-109 fix).

OwnerProxy.vy is the classic StableSwap owner proxy (0.3.10): deploy_plain_pool/deploy_gauge/apply_new_fee/accept_transfer_ownership/migrate_gauge_manager are permissionless BY DESIGN (commit steps are admin-guarded). deploy_gauge defaults _manager to msg.sender, making the caller the gauge manager. No lending-specific functions in this file despite the SCOPE.md label; its role as lending admin (if any) is via being set as factory admin elsewhere.

ChainlinkEMA.sol: defi.money upstream. EMA over Chainlink rounds with INTERVAL-bucketed observations; walks rounds backward in _calculateNewEMA (bounded by MAX_LOOKBACK=2*OBSERVATIONS outer iterations; inner walk unbounded by construction except roundId low-64-bits==1). Phase-change handling: new phase -> full recalculation; decimals reloaded on phase change (prior fix: a decimals change used to revert and freeze liquidations). No updatedAt recency check by design (EMA tolerates stale feeds).

WstGBPFxOracle.sol: price = min(burncost or cached rate, anchor*(1+0.25%/day*elapsed capped 7d)) * GBP/USD EMA. navprice()==0 means NAV paused -> uses cachedRedemptionRate. price()==1 wei when redemption rate is 0. price_w() updates anchor only on nonzero rates; cachedTimestamp/cachedRedemptionRate update on every price_w() call including zero-rate ones.

ReusdCrvUSDAdapter: min(1e18, feed.priceAsCrvusd()), hardcoded mainnet feed; no EMA; feed failures propagate. SyrupUSDCAdapter: convertToAssets delegates to convertToExitAssets (net of exit fees) by design.

Rate calculators: WstETH reads Lido Optimism TokenRateOracle history (2-point, daily assumption, documented stale/pause risks); SyrupUSDC keeps a 7-slot daily ring buffer (rate_w records at most one sample/day; rate() mirrors with a virtual sample); sDOLA uses previous week's revenue / current totalAssets; sfrxUSD uses rewardsCycleData + storedTotalAssets capped by maxDistributionPerSecondPerAsset (verify tuple order/scale against the Frax vault).
